relations.subject: Aloys Sprenger
relations.evidence: Sprenger studied medicine, natural sciences as well as oriental languages at the University of Vienna.

relations.subject: Aloys Sprenger
relations.evidence: In 1836 he moved to London, where he worked with the Earl of Munster on the latter's Geschichte der Kriegswissenschaften bei den mohammedanischen Völkern

relations.subject: Aloys Sprenger
relations.evidence: thence in 1843 to Calcutta, where he became principal of Delhi College.

relations.subject: Aloys Sprenger
relations.role: examiner, official government interpreter, and secretary
relations.evidence: In 1850 Sprenger was named examiner, official government interpreter, and secretary of the Asiatic Society of Calcutta.

relations.subject: Aloys Sprenger
relations.evidence: Sprenger took a position as professor of oriental languages at the University of Bern in 1857, moving in 1881 to Heidelberg.
